PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY  
Senior Program Manager and Business Transformation Leader with 14+ years in Banking & Financial Services, including over 10 years at 
HSBC leading enterprise-scale transformation, program governance, and operations delivery across Canada, the UK, Bermuda, India, and 
the Philippines. PMP® certified (PMI, 2026). 
Proven in owning complex, multi-site, multi-country program delivery, driving governance cadence, escalation management, and 
measurable efficiency outcomes. Deep grounding in banking operations, audit and controls readiness, and risk/compliance, combined with 
applied data and analytics fluency built to strengthen data-driven program leadership and automation-enabled transformation delivery.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE  
Independent Consultant — Business Transformation Jun 2024 – Present 
Independent transformation practice focused on formalizing project management expertise and building applied data/analytics capability — 
extending a decade of HSBC transformation leadership into structured, technology-enabled program delivery. 
• Completed PMP® certification (PMI, 2026), formalizing structured program delivery, governance, and stakeholder alignment practices 
built over a decade of transformation leadership. 
• Completed a PG Diploma in Data Science & Machine Learning with AI, including a project-based internship with Flip Robo 
Technologies (Jul–Dec 2024), to lead technology- and automation-enabled transformation with greater depth and credibility. 
• Applied prior HSBC transformation experience — process re-engineering, automation opportunity identification, and program 
governance — to self-directed case work and skill-building exercises. 
• Built additional depth in Agile and hybrid delivery models, risk management, and transformation execution frameworks. 
HSBC Electronic Data Processing India Pvt. Ltd. — Program Manager, Business TransformationSep 2013 – May 2024 (10 yrs 9 
mos) 
• Led business transformation and program governance across HSBC’s global Lending Services (Mortgages & Cards), spanning multi-
country operations across Canada, UK, and Bermuda. 
• Owned end-to-end delivery across 2 business entities (Canada Mortgages, Bermuda Cards), 3 delivery sites (Hyderabad, Kolkata, 
Manila) and 8 processes including French Mortgages — driving governance cadence, RAID/action tracking, and escalation 
management. 
• Led change and agile management workstreams during HSBC Canada’s business transition to RBC (Royal Bank of Canada), delivering 
full business continuity with zero service disruption. 
• Delivered productivity savings equivalent to 15+ FTEs through automation, RPA (UiPath, Blue Prism — business leadership 
exposure), OCR, and process re-engineering. 
• Built enterprise MI dashboards and analytical reporting using Power BI, SQL, and Python, improving decision-support turnaround 
times by over 60%. 
• Owned end-to-end regulatory, legal, and risk compliance for the business domain, ensuring processes operated within robust QC/QA 
systems and KPI frameworks, sustaining continuous readiness for SOX, Internal Audit, and PwC external audit engagements. 
• Led Business Contingency Planning — conducting regular contingency maintenance and testing with contingency sites and teams — 
and owned Control Monitoring Plans, risk mitigation strategies, and regulatory reporting of losses, near misses, and risk events against 
organizational thresholds and risk appetite. Maintained strong governance of KYC, AML, and Sanctions compliance, including regular 
risk-awareness training for teams. 
• Directed vendor coordination, workforce hygiene, capacity/demand planning, and forecasting to sustain SLA and TPS commitments. 
• Led, coached, and developed Team Leaders and Assistant Managers across large, multi-site teams, embedding Operational Excellence 
practices (Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement). 
• Partnered cross-functionally with Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and HR stakeholders to support platform migrations, 
operating model changes, and regulatory transitions.

Led cross-border re-migration of Canada Mortgage Operations from Bangalore and Malaysia to GSC Hyderabad, managing multi-location

Canada Mortgage French Process Re-Migration Program Feb 2020 – Aug 2020 
Led cross-border, multilingual re-migration of Canada French Mortgage Operations from GSC Krakow, Poland to GSC Hyderabad, ensuring 
uninterrupted service delivery and compliance adherence. 
Mortgage & Loan Booking/Funding (Drawdowns) Automation Program Sep 2020 – Feb 2021 
Directed automation of mortgage and loan booking/funding processes, reducing turnaround time from 5 days to 1 day and delivering 4+ FTE 
efficiency savings. 
Mortgage DocPac Follow-Up Process Automation Program Nov 2021 – Apr 2022 
Led an automated tracking and follow-up framework across a 4,000+ mortgage application pipeline, reducing turnaround from 180 to 60 days and 
improving legal-charge tracking accuracy.
